Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1918

Report for the Year 1918 and Budget for the Year 1919
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1919

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the figures printed on the fire-loss charts, the fold-out list of fires, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, the weather diagram and the graphs without printed figures are not. On the fold-out List of Fires the scan does not show the printed row labels (the trades), so its 76 rows are numbered; and the scan cuts off the right edge of Comparative Statement A, so its 1918 percentage column is unreadable. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense pages and fold-outs by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (43 cells). Chapters follow the printed contents (four page series, A to D, as printed; page 23B is missing from the scan).
